articles.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
articles.snippet: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

articles.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
articles.snippet: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.snippet: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

articles.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

articles.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
articles.snippet: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.
